What is a Document Portal and Why Do You Need One?

A document portal is a centralized platform where you can store, manage, and share documents with patients, colleagues, and other stakeholders. As an occupational therapist, you deal with a wide range of documents, including patient assessments, treatment plans, and progress reports. A document portal helps you keep these documents organized, up-to-date, and easily accessible.

With Base44, you can create a customized document portal that meets your specific requirements. Whether you need to store sensitive patient information or collaborate with team members, Base44 provides a secure and intuitive platform for all your documentation needs.
